confirmed: Scorer receives RGB-derived reference/query features; labels enter metrics and calibration after scoring.
All reference anchors remain in the weighted denominator; unmatched anchors contribute zero.
Spatial search uses translations, with no rotations or flips of time/frequency axes.
CALIB chooses one global recipe per checkpoint using declared recall/AUROC/order tie breaks.
Each target threshold is fixed from its CALIB negative scores with strict nextafter tie handling.
Union wrong-target alarm counts each event once even when several wrong targets or a correct target also alarm.
caveats: All frozen recipes are scored on TEST; report the CALIB-selected primary without posthoc switching.
Calibration budget is empirical, not a guaranteed future false-alarm bound.
Labels are physically present in evaluator event metadata but no code path sends them to the scorer.
This is a source review, not a second empirical TEST replay; final gates and source freeze are reviewed separately by root.
